svg.title: Map of West Africa: countries, rivers and lakes
svg.desc: The sixteen countries of West Africa (Mauritania, Senegal, The Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, Guinea, Sierra Leone, Liberia, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, Ghana, Togo, Benin, Niger, Nigeria and the island state of Cabo Verde), with the Rivers Niger, Benue, Volta and Senegal, Lake Volta, Kainji Lake and Lake Chad, the Atlantic Ocean and the Gulf of Guinea.
